name: Industrial Policy Resolution, 1956
change: Established a mixed economy model where both public and private sectors coexist, with key industries reserved for the state.
impact: Laid the foundation of India’s industrial structure but limited private sector growth initially.

name: New Industrial Policy, 1991
change: Dismantled industrial licensing, reduced government control, and opened sectors to private and foreign investment.
impact: Boosted industrial growth, competition, and efficiency, marking a shift toward a market-driven economy.

name: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Development Act, 2006
change: Provided legal framework for MSMEs including credit access, protection against delayed payments, and promotion of small enterprises.
impact: Strengthened MSME sector which contributes significantly to GDP and employment. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

name: Make in India Initiative, 2014
change: Encouraged domestic manufacturing through policy reforms, ease of doing business, and FDI liberalization.
impact: Boosted manufacturing sector and attracted global investment, though long-term output growth remains gradual.

name: Startup India Initiative, 2016
change: Provides tax benefits, funding support, and simplified compliance for startups.
impact: Promotes innovation and entrepreneurship, making India one of the largest startup ecosystems globally.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme, 2016
change: Provides bank loans to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for starting new businesses.
impact: Encourages inclusive business growth and reduces entry barriers for underrepresented groups.

name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme, 2020
change: Offers financial incentives to companies based on incremental production in key sectors like electronics and manufacturing.
impact: Boosts domestic manufacturing and global competitiveness while attracting foreign investment.

name: Udyam Registration Portal, 2020
change: Introduced a simplified online registration system for MSMEs to access government benefits and schemes.
impact: Improves ease of doing business for small enterprises and expands formalization of the sector. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

name: Atmanirbhar Bharat Industrial Package, 2020
change: Introduced financial support, credit guarantees, and policy reforms to strengthen domestic industries during COVID-19.
impact: Supports MSMEs and domestic manufacturing, promoting self-reliance and resilience.

name: National Logistics Policy, 2022
change: Focuses on improving logistics infrastructure, reducing transportation costs, and enhancing supply chain efficiency.
impact: Reduces cost of doing business and improves competitiveness of Indian industries in global markets.
